# Generated by `tools/ci-test-shard.py weights endpoints <log>` from a CI log of
# that suite; binaries under DEFAULT_WEIGHT are omitted. `<unit>` is the unit-
# test bundle's wall time and `lib:<module>` the summed seconds of that
# module's unit tests, which place the lib-part filters. Only balances the
# shards — a stale or missing entry never drops a test.

# each run's shard logs concatenated into one `weights` input: one run's
# timings swing up to ~2x, so a single log is a noisy sample.
